sloka: उत्तरं पुनरेवेदं निश्चित्य मनसा तया ।हनुमन् मम वृत्तान्तं वक्तुमर्हसि राघवे ।। ५.५८.१०४ ।।।।
transliteration: uttaraṁ punarevedaṁ niścitya manasā tayā ।hanuman mama vṛttāntaṁ vaktumarhasi rāghave ।। 5.58.104 ।।।।

translations.english: Having resolved it in her mind, she spoke to me once more: Hanuman, you ought to relate my plight to Rama.
